items.requirement: The desktop navbar contains Product, Workflows, Resources, Open source, and a distinct Get started action.
items.source: User request for multiple product-relevant links and submenus

items.requirement: The open Product dropdown contains Review desk, Guided walkthrough, Ask your agent, and Plan desk links.
The Product menu has five compact, content-sized link rows without oversized vertical gaps.
items.source: User-reported Product menu rows stretch on opening and move into place on hover

items.requirement: Plan desk is visibly labeled Prototype.
The Product dropdown includes a product-specific illustrative preview beside the links on desktop.
items.source: Reference dropdown has substantive side content

items.requirement: The navbar and dropdown preserve the landing page's light palette, restrained petrol blue accent, and Geist typography.
The dropdown floats above the hero without moving the page content.
Every menu link, menu footer and the Open source link lead to their own page on the site; GitHub stays reachable from the footer and the Open source page.
items.source: Human brief: each link and sublink gets its own page

items.requirement: The section of the current page is marked on its trigger, and the current page is marked inside its menu.
The dropdown unfolds from its trigger and folds back on dismissal; switching sections continuously resizes and repositions the same floating shell without stretching text.
items.source: Current human request: beautiful morphs entering, leaving, and inside navigation; verify through interaction

items.requirement: Switching navbar sections coordinates shell movement, panel slides and staged rows on one animation clock without delayed row opacity compounding the panel fade.
items.source: User correction: the morphs fight each other; preserve animations and synchronize them instead of deleting them. Verify frame-by-frame through interaction.

items.requirement: During menu and preview switching, outgoing text clears before incoming text becomes visible; intermediate frames never show two superimposed menus or illustrations.
items.source: User reports navigation still broken; a frozen 90ms Product-to-Roadmap frame on port 4321 showed overlapping blurred text. Verify intermediate frames, not just completed animation states.

items.requirement: The first click on a hover-opened trigger keeps its dropdown open. A second deliberate click dismisses it.
items.source: Real pointer reproduction on the user's port 4321: hovering Product and then clicking Product closed the menu.

items.requirement: Rapidly changing direction between navbar links continues from the currently rendered dropdown and content positions without snapping to a previous start or end state.
items.source: User request for ultra-smooth switching between links; verify interrupted transitions through interaction.

items.requirement: Menu and preview text stay unblurred throughout opening, switching and closing.
items.source: User reports excessive opening blur; inspect computed filters during the animation, including ancestor filters.

items.requirement: Hovering Product rows during a menu morph leaves the menu animation and its original finish time unchanged.
items.source: User reports continued unsmooth motion; preview changes canceled and restarted the shared 420ms animation. Verify animation identity and deadline during interruption.

items.requirement: Hovering Product rows moves one shared selection background and reveals the corresponding illustrative preview with staged content.
items.source: Current human request: motion inside the navigation; verify through interaction

items.requirement: At narrow widths the navbar collapses into a Menu toggle; opening it shows the same dropdown content and it is fully operable.
